mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances following positive GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic distress, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPI) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which erodes purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances following sustained CPI increases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% in a month signals a weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
